		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_pct = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = global.cwcm_h1_left }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.13699 }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_pct = cwcm_t_x }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwcm_h1_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_target > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_left = global.cwcm_h2_end }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwcm_h2_left min = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_pct = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = global.cwcm_h2_left }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.13699 }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_pct = cwcm_t_x }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwcm_h2_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_target > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_left = global.cwcm_h3_end }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwcm_h3_left min = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_pct = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = global.cwcm_h3_left }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.13699 }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_pct = cwcm_t_x }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwcm_h3_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_target > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_left = global.cwcm_l1_end }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwcm_l1_left min = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_pct = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = global.cwcm_l1_left }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.05495 }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_pct = cwcm_t_x }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwcm_l1_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_target > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_left = global.cwcm_l2_end }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwcm_l2_left min = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_pct = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = global.cwcm_l2_left }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.05495 }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_pct = cwcm_t_x }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwcm_l2_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_ncand = global.cwcm_nominees^num }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_count_progs = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_count_aid = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_workload = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ui_nact = cwcm_t_act }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ui_loadpct = cwcm_t_load }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_ui_loadpct = -1 }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwcm_ui_loadpct = 100 }
	round_variable = global.cwcm_ui_loadpct
}

# Any scope. Live count of the vote on the floor for the window (stamps and bar): For, Against, Not interested of the seated players.
COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_live_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_live_nv = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_live_nf = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_live_na = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_live_nn = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_stamp = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor > 0 } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_live_n = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_floor_issue } }
					set_variable = { cwcm_ui_stamp = cwcm_vote }
					add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_live_nv = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 1 } }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_live_nf = 1 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 2 } }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_live_na = 1 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 3 } }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_live_nn = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_item = 120 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ui_size = global.cwcm_floor_size }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_capacity_preview = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_code: an entry of the running list; temp cwcm_t_pct: its progress.
COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_run_pct = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_s1_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_s2_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_s3_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_s4_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_s5_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_s6_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 7 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_s7_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 8 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_s8_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 9 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_s9_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 10 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_s10_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 101 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_q1_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 102 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_q2_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 103 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_q3_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 104 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_q4_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 111 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_h1_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 112 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_h2_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 113 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_h3_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 121 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_l1_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 122 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_l2_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_code = 130 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = global.cwcm_ui_loadpct }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pct = 1.667 }
	}
}

# Country scope (viewer). Which view the Session card shows: the vote on the floor, a ratification of the Charter, or nothing; its cards and stamps.
COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_council_view = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_cview = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rslot = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_ritem = 0 }
	# year and number of the file shown
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_y = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_y = global.cwcm_epoch }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_y = 365 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_y = 0.499 }
	round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_y
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_y = 1970 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_cview = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fyear = cwcm_t_y }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fno = global.cwcm_floor_issue }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 1 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fby = global.cwcm_s1_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 2 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fby = global.cwcm_s2_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 3 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fby = global.cwcm_s3_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 4 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fby = global.cwcm_s4_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fby = global.cwcm_s5_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 6 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fby = global.cwcm_s6_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 7 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fby = global.cwcm_s7_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 8 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fby = global.cwcm_s8_by }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fby = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_fproc = 1 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_fproc = 3 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_fproc = 4 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_fproc = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fstepf = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_fproc = 7 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_fproc = 8 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_fproc = 10 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_fproc = 11 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_fstepf = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_fthr = 4 } check_variable = { cwcm_ui_fthr = 6 } } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_chipf = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_fthr = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_chipf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_fproc = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_chipf = 4 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_chipf = 2 }
		}
		# player cards and their stamps
		clear_array = cwcm_ui_vall
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					add_to_array = { PREV.cwcm_ui_vall = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_nv = cwcm_ui_vall^num }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = cwcm_ui_nv }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 3 }
		divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 4 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.499 }
		round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_r
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_r min = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpages = cwcm_t_r }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpage < cwcm_ui_vpages } } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpage = cwcm_ui_vpages }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpage = -1 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_vpage min = 0 }
		clear_array = cwcm_ui_vpg
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lo = cwcm_ui_vpage }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lo = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_hi = cwcm_t_lo }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_hi = 4 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = cwcm_ui_vall
			value = cwcm_t_val
			index = cwcm_t_idx
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_idx < cwcm_t_lo } } check_variable = { cwcm_t_idx < cwcm_t_hi } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_vpg = cwcm_t_val } }
		}
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpage1 = cwcm_ui_vpage }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpage1 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt1 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpg^num > 0 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt1 = cwcm_ui_vpg^0 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt2 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpg^num > 1 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt2 = cwcm_ui_vpg^1 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt3 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpg^num > 2 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt3 = cwcm_ui_vpg^2 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt4 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpg^num > 3 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt4 = cwcm_ui_vpg^3 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt1s = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt1d = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt1 > 0 } }
			var:cwcm_ui_vt1 = { set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_st = cwcm_ui_stamp } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt1s = cwcm_t_st }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt1s = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt2s = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt2d = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt2 > 0 } }
			var:cwcm_ui_vt2 = { set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_st = cwcm_ui_stamp } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt2s = cwcm_t_st }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt2s = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt3s = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt3d = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt3 > 0 } }
			var:cwcm_ui_vt3 = { set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_st = cwcm_ui_stamp } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt3s = cwcm_t_st }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt3s = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt4s = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt4d = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt4 > 0 } }
			var:cwcm_ui_vt4 = { set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_st = cwcm_ui_stamp } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt4s = cwcm_t_st }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt4s = 1 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rslot = 1 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_ritem = global.cwcm_s1_item }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rn = global.cwcm_s1_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rm = global.cwcm_s1_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rissue = global.cwcm_s1_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rslot = 2 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_ritem = global.cwcm_s2_item }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rn = global.cwcm_s2_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rm = global.cwcm_s2_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rissue = global.cwcm_s2_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rslot = 3 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_ritem = global.cwcm_s3_item }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rn = global.cwcm_s3_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rm = global.cwcm_s3_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rissue = global.cwcm_s3_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rslot = 4 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_ritem = global.cwcm_s4_item }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rn = global.cwcm_s4_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rm = global.cwcm_s4_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rissue = global.cwcm_s4_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rslot = 5 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_ritem = global.cwcm_s5_item }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rn = global.cwcm_s5_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rm = global.cwcm_s5_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rissue = global.cwcm_s5_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rslot = 6 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_ritem = global.cwcm_s6_item }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rn = global.cwcm_s6_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rm = global.cwcm_s6_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rissue = global.cwcm_s6_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rslot = 7 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_ritem = global.cwcm_s7_item }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rn = global.cwcm_s7_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rm = global.cwcm_s7_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rissue = global.cwcm_s7_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rslot = 8 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_ritem = global.cwcm_s8_item }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rn = global.cwcm_s8_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rm = global.cwcm_s8_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rissue = global.cwcm_s8_issue }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rslot > 0 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_cview = 2 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_ryear = cwcm_t_y }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rno = cwcm_ui_rissue }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rstepf = 4 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpend = cwcm_ui_rm }
			subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpend = cwcm_ui_rn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = cwcm_ui_rm }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_m min = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_p = cwcm_ui_rn }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_p = 100 }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_p = cwcm_t_m }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rbarf = cwcm_t_p }
			divide_variable = { cwcm_ui_rbarf = 5 }
			round_variable = cwcm_ui_rbarf
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rbarf = 1 }
			clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_rbarf min = 1 max = 21 }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_rslot = 1 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 3 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 6 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 2 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 7 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 6 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 5 }
						}
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = 0 }
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 3 } }
								check_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 > 0 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = cwcm_ratdue_1 }
							subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = global.num_days }
							clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_rdays min = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_rslot = 2 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 3 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 6 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 2 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 7 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 6 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 5 }
						}
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = 0 }
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 3 } }
								check_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 > 0 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = cwcm_ratdue_2 }
							subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = global.num_days }
							clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_rdays min = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_rslot = 3 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 3 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 6 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 2 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 7 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 6 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 5 }
						}
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = 0 }
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 3 } }
								check_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 > 0 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = cwcm_ratdue_3 }
							subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = global.num_days }
							clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_rdays min = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_rslot = 4 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_4 = 3 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 6 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_4 = 2 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 7 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_4 = 6 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 5 }
						}
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = 0 }
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_4 = 3 } }
								check_variable = { cwcm_rat_4 > 0 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = cwcm_ratdue_4 }
							subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = global.num_days }
							clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_rdays min = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_rslot = 5 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_5 = 3 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 6 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_5 = 2 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 7 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_5 = 6 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 5 }
						}
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = 0 }
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_5 = 3 } }
								check_variable = { cwcm_rat_5 > 0 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = cwcm_ratdue_5 }
							subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = global.num_days }
							clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_rdays min = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_rslot = 6 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_6 = 3 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 6 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_6 = 2 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 7 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_6 = 6 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 5 }
						}
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = 0 }
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_6 = 3 } }
								check_variable = { cwcm_rat_6 > 0 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = cwcm_ratdue_6 }
							subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = global.num_days }
							clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_rdays min = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_rslot = 7 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 3 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 6 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 2 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 7 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 6 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 5 }
						}
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = 0 }
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 3 } }
								check_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 > 0 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = cwcm_ratdue_7 }
							subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = global.num_days }
							clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_rdays min = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_rslot = 8 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 3 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 6 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 2 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 7 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 6 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 8 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rst = 5 }
						}
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = 0 }
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 3 } }
								check_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 > 0 } }
							set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = cwcm_ratdue_8 }
							subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_ui_rdays = global.num_days }
							clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_rdays min = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clear_array = cwcm_ui_vall
			clear_array = cwcm_ui_rpassive
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { is_ai = no }
						add_to_array = { PREV.cwcm_ui_vall = THIS }
					}
					else = {
						add_to_array = { PREV.cwcm_ui_rpassive = THIS }
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_nv = cwcm_ui_vall^num }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = cwcm_ui_nv }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 3 }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 4 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.499 }
			round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_r
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_r min = 1 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpages = cwcm_t_r }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpage < cwcm_ui_vpages } } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpage = cwcm_ui_vpages }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpage = -1 }
			}
			clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_vpage min = 0 }
			clear_array = cwcm_ui_vpg
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lo = cwcm_ui_vpage }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lo = 4 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_hi = cwcm_t_lo }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_hi = 4 }
			for_each_loop = {
				array = cwcm_ui_vall
				value = cwcm_t_val
				index = cwcm_t_idx
				if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_idx < cwcm_t_lo } } check_variable = { cwcm_t_idx < cwcm_t_hi } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_vpg = cwcm_t_val } }
			}
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpage1 = cwcm_ui_vpage }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpage1 = 1 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt1 = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpg^num > 0 } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt1 = cwcm_ui_vpg^0 }
			}
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt2 = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpg^num > 1 } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt2 = cwcm_ui_vpg^1 }
			}
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt3 = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpg^num > 2 } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt3 = cwcm_ui_vpg^2 }
			}
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt4 = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vpg^num > 3 } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt4 = cwcm_ui_vpg^3 }
			}
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt1s = 5 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt1d = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt1 > 0 } }
				var:cwcm_ui_vt1 = { set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_st = cwcm_ui_rst } set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_dd = cwcm_ui_rdays } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt1s = cwcm_t_st }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt1d = cwcm_t_dd }
			}
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt2s = 5 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt2d = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt2 > 0 } }
				var:cwcm_ui_vt2 = { set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_st = cwcm_ui_rst } set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_dd = cwcm_ui_rdays } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt2s = cwcm_t_st }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt2d = cwcm_t_dd }
			}
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt3s = 5 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt3d = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt3 > 0 } }
				var:cwcm_ui_vt3 = { set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_st = cwcm_ui_rst } set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_dd = cwcm_ui_rdays } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt3s = cwcm_t_st }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt3d = cwcm_t_dd }
			}
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt4s = 5 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt4d = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt4 > 0 } }
				var:cwcm_ui_vt4 = { set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_st = cwcm_ui_rst } set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_dd = cwcm_ui_rdays } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt4s = cwcm_t_st }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_vt4d = cwcm_t_dd }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Viewer scope. Rows of the paged lists (an entry of a dynamic list cannot show variables of its element).
COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_rows = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m1 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rows^num > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m1 = cwcm_ui_rows^0 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m2 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rows^num > 1 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m2 = cwcm_ui_rows^1 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m3 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rows^num > 2 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m3 = cwcm_ui_rows^2 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m4 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rows^num > 3 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m4 = cwcm_ui_rows^3 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m5 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rows^num > 4 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m5 = cwcm_ui_rows^4 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m6 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rows^num > 5 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m6 = cwcm_ui_rows^5 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m7 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rows^num > 6 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m7 = cwcm_ui_rows^6 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m8 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rows^num > 7 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m8 = cwcm_ui_rows^7 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m9 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rows^num > 8 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m9 = cwcm_ui_rows^8 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m10 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rows^num > 9 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m10 = cwcm_ui_rows^9 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m11 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rows^num > 10 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m11 = cwcm_ui_rows^10 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m12 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rows^num > 11 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m12 = cwcm_ui_rows^11 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m13 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rows^num > 12 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m13 = cwcm_ui_rows^12 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m14 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rows^num > 13 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_m14 = cwcm_ui_rows^13 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rc1 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_recips^num > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rc1 = cwcm_ui_recips^0 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rc2 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_recips^num > 1 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rc2 = cwcm_ui_recips^1 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rc3 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_recips^num > 2 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rc3 = cwcm_ui_recips^2 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rc4 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_recips^num > 3 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rc4 = cwcm_ui_recips^3 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp1 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpassive^num > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp1 = cwcm_ui_rpassive^0 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp2 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpassive^num > 1 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp2 = cwcm_ui_rpassive^1 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp3 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpassive^num > 2 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp3 = cwcm_ui_rpassive^2 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp4 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpassive^num > 3 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp4 = cwcm_ui_rpassive^3 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp5 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpassive^num > 4 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp5 = cwcm_ui_rpassive^4 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp6 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpassive^num > 5 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp6 = cwcm_ui_rpassive^5 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp7 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpassive^num > 6 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp7 = cwcm_ui_rpassive^6 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp8 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpassive^num > 7 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_s_rp8 = cwcm_ui_rpassive^7 }
	}

		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_sec8_n > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_secn8 = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_secn8 = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec8_st = 2 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_secw8 = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec8_st = 1 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_secw8 = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_secw8 = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 8 } check_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 8 } } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_secf8 = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_secf8 = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_plan_end = global.cwcm_plan_year }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_plan_end = 4 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_plan_curend = global.cwcm_plan_cur }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_plan_curend = 4 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_plan_closeyear = global.cwcm_plan_year }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_plan_closeyear = -1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_any = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_cur > 1970 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_any = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_IND = cwcm_pl_IND }
	multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_IND = 100 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_ZP = cwcm_pl_ZP }
	multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_ZP = 100 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_FO = cwcm_pl_FO }
	multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_FO = 100 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_REX = cwcm_pl_REX }
	multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_REX = 100 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_AP = cwcm_pl_AP }
	multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_AP = 100 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_KG = cwcm_pl_KG }
	multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_KG = 100 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_IB = cwcm_pl_IB }
	multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_IB = 100 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_HM = cwcm_pl_HM }
	multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_HM = 100 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_PP = cwcm_pl_PP }
	multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_PP = 100 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_BK = cwcm_pl_BK }
	multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pl_BK = 100 }
	# clearing and our government
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_quota_pct = global.cwcm_st_q }
	multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_quota_pct = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cwcm_quota } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_quota = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_myquota = cwcm_quota }
	multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_myquota = 100 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_nloans = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_target > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_nloans = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_target > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_nloans = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_leave_days = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_leaving }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_leave_days = cwcm_leave_due }
		subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_ui_leave_days = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_leave_days min = 0 }
	}
	# members and partners table
	clear_array = cwcm_ui_rows_all
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			add_to_array = { PREV.cwcm_ui_rows_all = THIS }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_watch
		if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } check_variable = { cwcm_status > 0 } } add_to_array = { PREV.cwcm_ui_rows_all = THIS } }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_nrows = cwcm_ui_rows_all^num }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = cwcm_ui_nrows }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 13 }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 14 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.499 }
	round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_r
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_r min = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_mpages = cwcm_t_r }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_mpage < cwcm_ui_mpages } } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_mpage = cwcm_ui_mpages }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_mpage = -1 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_mpage min = 0 }
	clear_array = cwcm_ui_rows
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lo = cwcm_ui_mpage }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lo = 14 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_hi = cwcm_t_lo }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_hi = 14 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cwcm_ui_rows_all
		value = cwcm_t_val
		index = cwcm_t_idx
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_idx < cwcm_t_lo } } check_variable = { cwcm_t_idx < cwcm_t_hi } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rows = cwcm_t_val } }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_mpage1 = cwcm_ui_mpage }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_mpage1 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_tab = 4 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_ui_mode = 3 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_ui_recip > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_aid_preview = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_rows = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_values = yes
}

# Any scope. Something changed: refresh the open windows only.
COLDWAR_CMEA_touch = {
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_global = yes
	clear_temp_array = cwcm_t_closed
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_viewers
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes
				is_ai = no
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_open }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_refresh = yes
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_array = { cwcm_t_closed = THIS }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwcm_t_closed
		remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_viewers = THIS }
	}
}

	}
	# effective threshold of a recommendation after the planning organ or the Charter of 1979
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel_thr = 4 }
			has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_supranational }

	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel_thr = 4 }
			has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_interest_unblocked }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel_thr = 6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_is_secretary = yes }
		multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel_cost = 0.5 }
	}
}

# Country scope (viewer). Countries that can be chosen for the selected proposal; read only when a proposal is selected.
COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_build_targets = {
	clear_array = cwcm_ui_targets_all
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 61 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_watch
			if = { limit = { exists = yes check_variable = { cwcm_status = 2 } } add_to_array = { PREV.cwcm_ui_targets_all = THIS } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 62 } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = FIN FIN = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = FIN } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = IRQ IRQ = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = IRQ } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = MEX MEX = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = MEX } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = IND IND = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = IND } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SYR SYR = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = SYR } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = EGY EGY = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = EGY } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ALG ALG = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = ALG } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = LBA LBA = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = LBA } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = AFG AFG = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = AFG } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ETH ETH = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = ETH } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = AGL AGL = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = AGL } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = MOZ MOZ = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = MOZ } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = NIC NIC = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = NIC } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SYE SYE = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = SYE } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = LAO LAO = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = LAO } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = NKO NKO = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = NKO } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = CUB CUB = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = CUB } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = VIE VIE = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = VIE } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } NOT = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 } } NOT = { is_in_array = { array = PREV.cwcm_ui_targets_all value = THIS } } }
			add_to_array = { PREV.cwcm_ui_targets_all = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 63 } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = AFG AFG = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = AFG } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = AGL AGL = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = AGL } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ETH ETH = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = ETH } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = LAO LAO = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = LAO } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = MOZ MOZ = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = MOZ } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = NIC NIC = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = NIC } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SYE SYE = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = SYE } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = CUB CUB = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = CUB } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = VIE VIE = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = VIE } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = NKO NKO = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = NKO } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = IRQ IRQ = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = IRQ } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SYR SYR = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = SYR } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = LBA LBA = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = LBA } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ALG ALG = { check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets_all = ALG } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } NOT = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } check_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 } NOT = { is_in_array = { array = PREV.cwcm_ui_targets_all value = THIS } } }
			add_to_array = { PREV.cwcm_ui_targets_all = THIS }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_ntargets = cwcm_ui_targets_all^num }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = cwcm_ui_ntargets }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 15 }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 16 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.499 }
	round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_r
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_r min = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_tpages = cwcm_t_r }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_tpage < cwcm_ui_tpages } } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_tpage = cwcm_ui_tpages }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_tpage = -1 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_tpage min = 0 }
	clear_array = cwcm_ui_targets
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lo = cwcm_ui_tpage }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lo = 16 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_hi = cwcm_t_lo }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_hi = 16 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cwcm_ui_targets_all
		value = cwcm_t_val
		index = cwcm_t_idx
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_idx < cwcm_t_lo } } check_variable = { cwcm_t_idx < cwcm_t_hi } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_targets = cwcm_t_val } }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_tpage1 = cwcm_ui_tpage }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_tpage1 = 1 }
}

# Country scope (viewer). Player countries outside the Council (absent players of the last year included), by continent. Runs only when the player opens the tab, filters or turns the page.
COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_build_recipients = {
	clear_array = cwcm_ui_recips_all
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_cont = cwcm_ui_cont }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes }
			NOT = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
			OR = { is_ai = no has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen }
			OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_cont = 0 } AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_cont = 1 } is_in_europe = yes } AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_cont = 2 } is_in_the_middle_east = yes } AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_cont = 3 } is_in_asia = yes } AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_cont = 4 } is_in_africa = yes } AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_cont = 5 } is_in_the_americas = yes } AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_cont = 6 } is_in_oceania = yes } }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 } }
		add_to_array = { PREV.cwcm_ui_recips_all = THIS }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_nrecips = cwcm_ui_recips_all^num }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = cwcm_ui_nrecips }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 3 }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 4 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.499 }
	round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_r
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_r min = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpages = cwcm_t_r }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpage < cwcm_ui_rpages } } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpage = cwcm_ui_rpages }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpage = -1 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_rpage min = 0 }
	clear_array = cwcm_ui_recips
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lo = cwcm_ui_rpage }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lo = 4 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_hi = cwcm_t_lo }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_hi = 4 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cwcm_ui_recips_all
		value = cwcm_t_val
		index = cwcm_t_idx
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_idx < cwcm_t_lo } } check_variable = { cwcm_t_idx < cwcm_t_hi } } add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_recips = cwcm_t_val } }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpage1 = cwcm_ui_rpage }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rpage1 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_recip > 0 }
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = cwcm_ui_recips_all value = cwcm_ui_recip } } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_recip = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope (viewer). Live preview of a programme abroad from the real values of the recipient and the capacity of every player member.
COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_aid_preview = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_recip > 0 }
			var:cwcm_ui_recip = { exists = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_S = cwcm_ui_size }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_S = 0.5 }
		var:cwcm_ui_recip = {
			COLDWAR_CMEA_calc_eff = yes
			COLDWAR_CMEA_reform_gap = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@oil }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@oil }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@steel }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@steel }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 2 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@aluminium }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@aluminium }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 3 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@chromium }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@chromium }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 4 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@tungsten }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@tungsten }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 5 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@rubber }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@rubber }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 6 }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_r_gdp = gdp_total }
			set_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_r_unemp = total_unemployed_percentage_display }
			multiply_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_r_unemp = 100 }
			set_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_r_V = cwcm_t_V }
			set_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_r_res = cwcm_t_res }
			set_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_r_gap = cwcm_t_gap }
			set_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_r_eff = cwcm_t_eff }
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = imp_eco_1_dynamic_modifier } }
				set_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_r_dev = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = imp_eco_3_dynamic_modifier } }
				set_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_r_dev = 3 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_r_dev = 2 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_al = mdcw_cw_alignment }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.4 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwcm_ui_type = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = cwcm_t_S }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 1.5 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_SE = cwcm_t_S }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_SE = cwcm_t_eff }
		# what the recipient gets (per cent or flat, after size and E)
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_g2 = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_g3 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_type = 1 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_g1 = 8 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_type = 2 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_g1 = 6 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_type = 3 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_g1 = 0.03 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_type = 4 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_g1 = 10 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_g2 = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_type = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_g1 = 5 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_g2 = 3 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_g3 = 0.02 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_g1 = 8 }
		}
		multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_g1 = cwcm_t_SE }
		multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_g2 = cwcm_t_SE }
		multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_g3 = cwcm_t_SE }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_type = 6 } }
			clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_pv_g1 max = 12 }
		}
		# return values
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_x1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m2 = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_d1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_d2 = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_f = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_ret = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_M = cwcm_ui_r_gdp }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_M = 50 }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_M min = 0.2 max = 2 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_f = cwcm_t_M }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m1 = 1.5 }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m1 = cwcm_t_M }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m1 = cwcm_t_S }
			clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_pv_m1 max = 3 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m2 = 0.5 }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m2 = cwcm_t_M }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m2 = cwcm_t_S }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_d2 = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_d2 = cwcm_t_S }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_x1 = 3 }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_x1 = cwcm_t_S }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_ret = 2 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_R = cwcm_ui_r_V }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_R = 20 }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_R min = 0.25 max = 2 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_f = cwcm_t_R }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_RS = cwcm_t_R }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_RS = cwcm_t_S }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_r_res = 1 } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m1 = 4 }
				multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m1 = cwcm_t_RS }
				clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_pv_m1 max = 10 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_r_res = 6 } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m1 = 0.5 }
				multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m1 = cwcm_t_RS }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m1 = 1 }
				multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m1 = cwcm_t_RS }
			}
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_d1 = 8 }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_d1 = cwcm_t_S }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_d2 = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_d2 = cwcm_t_RS }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_ret = 3 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_U = cwcm_ui_r_unemp }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_U = 8 }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_U min = 0.25 max = 2 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_f = cwcm_t_U }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_US = cwcm_t_U }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_US = cwcm_t_S }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m1 = 0.5 }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m1 = cwcm_t_US }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_x1 = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_x1 = cwcm_t_S }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_d1 = 5 }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_d1 = cwcm_t_US }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_ret = 4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_GS = cwcm_ui_r_gap }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_GS = cwcm_t_S }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_d1 = 0.02 }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_d1 = cwcm_t_GS }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_d2 = 2 }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_d2 = cwcm_t_GS }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_ret = 5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_al = 0 } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_x1 = 25 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_al = 1 } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_x1 = 15 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_al = 3 } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_x1 = 15 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_al = 1 } }
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m1 = 15 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_m1 = 5 }
			}
		}
		# cost and capacity: our share of the monthly cost by GDP among the members
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_cost = cwcm_t_c }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_share = cwcm_t_c }
		multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_share = 230.77 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_mg = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_mg = gdp_total }
			}
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_mg min = 0.001 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_gs = gdp_total }
		divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_gs = cwcm_t_mg }
		multiply_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_share = cwcm_t_gs }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_add = cwcm_ui_size }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_size_to_malus = yes
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_pv_capk = cwcm_t_addm }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_capacity_preview_build = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_addm: capacity of every player member now and with one more programme (cwcm_pb_*).
COLDWAR_CMEA_capacity_preview_build = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = cwcm_t_addm }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_m max = 3 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { cwcm_pb_now = mdcw_cw_cap_max }
				set_variable = { cwcm_pb_used = mdcw_cw_cap_used }
				set_variable = { cwcm_pb_after = mdcw_cw_cap_max }
				subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_pb_after = cwcm_aidcap }
				subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_pb_after = cwcm_t_m }
				set_variable = { cwcm_pb_newt = 0 }
				set_variable = { cwcm_pb_newp = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_pb_used > cwcm_pb_after }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_find_newest = yes
					set_variable = { cwcm_pb_newt = cwcm_t_bestn }
					set_variable = { cwcm_pb_newp = cwcm_t_bestc }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
